note: Every operation the LaTeX Studio interface offers and how an assistant working in the open editor reaches it. via names a declared action, read or navigation, or 'buffer edit' (a change in the open file's editor); 'none' carries the reason.

operations.ui: Type and edit text in the open file
Bold, italic, itemize, enumerate and figure buttons (Mod-B, Mod-I)
Edit another project file (open it, then type)
Move the cursor or scroll to a line

operations.reason: The editor history belongs to the owner; every assistant change is undone on its own in the review.

operations.ui: Open a file from the file tree
Expand or collapse a folder in the tree
operations.reason: Tree display state only; opening a file expands its folders.
Reads a file from the owner's computer, outside the application.

operations.ui: Jump to a section from the outline
Compile (button, Mod-Enter, retry after a failed build)
Click in the PDF to jump to the source line
Locate the current line in the PDF
operations.reason: Moves the owner's reading position in the PDF only; no project content changes.

operations.ui: Zoom the PDF in or out
operations.reason: Reading preference only; no project content changes.
Leaves the application (saves a file on the owner's computer).
The owner's preference for automatic background builds, not project content.
The owner's network policy for the TeX runtime.
Interface preference only.
Instructions the owner writes for the assistant; the assistant does not rewrite its own brief (the host accepts it from the owner only).

operations.ui: Git panel: branch, changed files and history
Show the diff of a changed file

operations.reason: Git mutations are reserved to the owner by the host and are not undone by the review.
Git mutation reserved to the owner; reaches the network.
Publishes outside the application and cannot be undone.
Git mutation reserved to the owner; chooses where the project is published.
Git mutation reserved to the owner.

operations.ui: Accept or reject a background AI proposal
operations.reason: Only the owner's decision applies a background proposal (project rule).

operations.ui: Copy local draft after a save conflict
operations.reason: Writes to the owner's clipboard, outside the application.

operations.ui: Reload file after a save conflict
operations.reason: Discards the local draft; resolving a conflict is the owner's decision and is never done silently.
Registering host folders is reserved to the owner by the host; the assistant works inside the open project.
Creates a folder on the host outside the open project; reserved to the owner.
Network download into a new host folder; reserved to the owner.

operations.ui: Open a recent project or go back to the project list
operations.reason: Leaves the open project the assistant works in.

operations.ui: Sidebar toggle and Files / Outline / Git switch
operations.reason: Layout only.

operations.ui: Source / PDF tabs on narrow screens
operations.reason: Layout only.
Layout only, owned by the surrounding window.
Display only.

beyondInterface.note: The interface has no rename or move; the assistant renames text files by writing the copy and removing the unchanged original, both revision-checked.
The interface has no delete; the assistant deletes text files of at most 1 MiB whose bytes its undo restores exactly.
